portalsHeaders.title: How ASTU-AMS Works
portalsHeaders.description: From registration to real impact — here's how our platform empowers alumni, employers, and the university community in four simple steps.

portals.title: CREATE YOUR PROFILE
points: Build your verified professional identity and showcase your education, skills and experience.
Access verified alumni directory, job listings, and career events.
portals.description: Build your verified professional identity and showcase your education, skills and experience.

portals.title: DISCOVER OPPORTUNITIES
points: Find jobs, internships, mentorship and career opportunities across verified partner firms.
Connect directly with hiring engineering managers and alumni founders.
portals.description: Find jobs, internships, mentorship and career opportunities across premier tech and engineering employers.

portals.title: CONNECT & NETWORK
points: Join your departmental alumni chapter, attend events, and network with industry leaders worldwide.
Participate in high-impact mentorship tracks and regional symposiums.
portals.description: Join your departmental alumni chapter, attend events, and network with industry leaders worldwide.

overview.title: ASTU-AMS Overview
overview.subtitle: An integrated Alumni Management System connecting graduates, employers, and departments. Developed in-house by ASTU to enable longitudinal employment tracking and accreditation compliance.

sections.heading: What is ASTU-AMS?
sections.body: ASTU-AMS is a comprehensive alumni management platform designed to bridge the gap between Adama Science and Technology University graduates, employers, and academic departments. With nearly three decades since ASTU's establishment, the platform boasts 1,238+ alumni members across 5 fields of study succeeding in business ventures, national and international companies, research institutes, and leadership positions.

sections.heading: Background & Rationale
sections.body: ASTU previously lacked a centralized, automated system to track graduate career trajectories. Graduate data was fragmented across departments and the Registrar's office. Without a unified digital ecosystem, the university remained unable to perform meaningful longitudinal analysis or maintain continuous relationships with its alumni network. The ASTU-AMS solves this by providing a centralized alumni database integrated with the Registrar and ERP systems.

sections.heading: Core Mission
sections.body: To foster professional growth, streamline talent acquisition, and drive academic innovation through data-driven insights and seamless connectivity between all stakeholders. The system provides verified tracer study data required by the Education and Training Authority (ETA) and international accreditation bodies.

sections.heading: Key Modules
sections.body: Alumni Registration & Verification, Profile Management, Automated Tracer Engine & Survey Logic, Event Calendar & RSVP, Mentorship & Job Board, Employer Portal & Analytics Dashboards, Messaging & Notifications, and Document Request Services.

sections.heading: Technical Architecture
sections.body: Built with React.js frontend and Node.js/PostgreSQL backend with RESTful APIs. Integrated with Google Sheets API, Telebirr, and institutional Email/SMS APIs. Analytics dashboards power accreditation readiness. Hosted on secure university servers with role-based access and data security protocols.

Wakjira (Adjunct Faculty, Idaho State University, USA), and Melaku Assefa (Global Operational Excellence Director, High-Tech Startup Germany).

sections.heading: National Leadership & Public Service

Assefa Dida (General Manager, Assefa Dida General & Water Work Contractor).

sections.heading: Academic & Technological Innovation at ASTU
sections.body: Many distinguished alumni continue their impact within ASTU faculty and research centers, such as Dr. Tafesse Asrat Abera (College of Electrical Engineering & Computing, Gold Medalist 2001), Dr. Habtamu Beri (Manufacturing Technology), Alemayehu Wakjira, PhD (Automotive Engineering), and Mr. Niguse Assefa.

knowledgeDocuments.title: ASTU Campus Location, Overview & Contact Directory
knowledgeDocuments.description: ASTU campus location, faculties, research laboratories, admissions, and verified contact directory.
knowledgeDocuments.rawContent:
# ASTU Campus Location & Directory
Adama Science and Technology University (ASTU) is a premier national STEM institution located in Adama (Nazret), Oromia Region, Ethiopia (~100km southeast of Addis Ababa along the expressway).
Campus Facilities:
• Main Campus: Houses university central administration, student services, Central Library, and lecture facilities.
• Research Complex: Houses centers of excellence in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy, and Advanced Manufacturing.
• Convocation Hall: Hosts annual graduation ceremonies, research symposiums, and national employer career fairs.
Admissions & Entrance:
• Undergraduate (BSc): Administered through the Ministry of Education (MoE) national university placement for top-performing STEM students.
• Postgraduate (MSc/PhD): Coordinated directly by the ASTU Directorate of Postgraduate Studies.
Contact Information:
• Alumni Relations: alumni@astu.edu.et
• Registrar Directorate: registrar@astu.edu.et | Campus Block 102
• Telephone: +251 22 110 0001
• Postal: P.O. Box 1888, Adama, Ethiopia

knowledgeDocuments.title: ASTU Portal Registration & Account Activation Guide
knowledgeDocuments.description: Step-by-step guidance for alumni, students, and employers to create and verify portal accounts.
knowledgeDocuments.rawContent:
# How to Register on ASTU-AMS
Account Registration Steps:
1. Click the Register button on the top navigation bar.
2. Select your user role: Alumni, Student, or Partner Employer.
3. Enter your full name, student ID number, graduation batch year, and active email address.
4. Create a secure password.
5. Verify the one-time code sent to your email to activate your account.
6. Once verified, complete your career profile and skills portfolio to receive tailored job recommendations.

knowledgeDocuments.description: Core engineering and applied science schools, departments, and skill requirements.
knowledgeDocuments.rawContent:
# Engineering Programs & Department Directory
Adama Science and Technology University is a premier STEM institution organized into key engineering departments:
• Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) and Software Engineering (SWE)
• Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE)
• Mechanical Engineering (ME)
• Civil Engineering & Architecture (CE)
• Applied Natural Sciences (Applied Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics)
Curriculum Focus:
Hands-on laboratory training, senior capstone innovation projects, and mandatory industrial internships with national enterprise partners.

knowledgeDocuments.rawContent:

ASTU-AMS connects graduates with verified corporate and government employers across Ethiopia.

knowledgeDocuments.title: ASTU Graduate Tracer Studies & National MoE Benchmarks
knowledgeDocuments.description: Institutional outcomes, national MoE alignment, graduate employment rates, and curriculum review surveys.
knowledgeDocuments.rawContent:
# Wave 3 Graduate Tracer Study Guidelines
The ASTU Graduate Tracer Study is a longitudinal survey conducted at 6, 12, and 24 months post-graduation to track graduate employment outcomes.
Key Institutional Telemetry:
• Overall ASTU Graduate Employment Rate: 55.0%
• Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) Placement: 75.0%
• Software Engineering (SWE) Placement: 63.0%
• Average Starting Salary: ETB 19,185 per month
• Top Software Engineering Starting Salary: ETB 23,400 per month
• Average Time to Employment: 16.3 months
Your responses guide ASTU curriculum updates and ensure HERQA / ETA quality accreditation standards.

knowledgeDocuments.title: ASTU Official Registrar Services & Academic Transcript Manual
knowledgeDocuments.description: Official university policies for requesting transcripts, degree certificates, and medium of instruction letters.
knowledgeDocuments.rawContent:
# Official Transcript Request Procedures
Adama Science and Technology University alumni and graduating students can request official academic transcripts through the ASTU-AMS Registrar portal.
1. Sign in to your verified Alumni account.
2. Navigate to Document Services -> Request Document.
3. Select the document type: Official Transcript, Degree Certificate Copy, or English Medium of Instruction Letter.
4. Provide the delivery destination address or institutional recipient email.
5. Standard Registrar processing SLA is 24 to 48 business hours.
6. Track processing status in real time under My Document Requests.
Registrar Contact: registrar@astu.edu.et | Campus Block 102
